q1: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f1, (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f2 WHERE f1.drinker < f2.drinker AND f1.st = f2.st
q2: SELECT d1.drinker AS drinkerA, d2.drinker AS drinkerB FROM frequents AS d1, frequents AS d2 WHERE d1.drinker < d2.drinker GROUP BY d1.drinker, d2.drinker HAVING SUM(d1.times_a_week) = (SELECT SUM(d3.times_a_week) FROM frequents AS d3 WHERE d3.drinker = d2.drinker)
